response.reconstructed_markdown:
The standard deduction for salaried employees under the new tax regime in India is ₹75,000. [0]

- Flat Deduction: It is a flat deduction subtracted directly from your gross salary or pension income before tax calculation, requiring no investment proofs or expense bills.
- Applicability: Available to all salaried individuals and pensioners opting for the [Income Tax Department](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAVpxWuH8vCrjSVdRGb1S11MZXAJkwtoAt40NZo86D5nMRpsyFZcnjawQAbqVUXNwjgceCjnEIKORPHNyYhKdbh0MUjFr0QoVpiBq4oarjXinq3qA) new tax framework. [0] [1]

If you would like, I can help you:

- Compare your tax liability under the old vs. new tax regime
- Estimate your net taxable income based on your gross salary
